newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end firmer, still below resistance.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end firmer, still below resistance.

text.p: NYCE November frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed firmer as the November contract drifted closer toward 115.00, a heavily-traded strike price, on the contract's options expiry.

November is not likely to pierce that key level until the U.S. Department of Agriculture releases it's estimate for the Florida crop next Friday, industry sources said. The previous estimate put the crop at 203.2 million 90-lb boxes.
"Everything now is tied to that estimate," an analyst said. "We're really not sure where it might land, so everybody is waiting."
Expectations in general are for a stronger forecast than last month. Players monitor closely the first official USDA report for the Florida crop.
Technically, selling is not likely to emerge until the spot month falls below 103.00, and buying will remain sparse until November hits 116.00, analysts said.
The November contract settled up 1.10 at 113.20, having ranged from 114.50 to 112.50. The back months finished 0.45 and 0.35 weaker.
